story.abigail.cave-invitation.02a.aiBrie: Abigail feels more willing to open up because the player cherished her quartz. She proposes exploring the mines together, admitting she is both excited and nervous. Ask whether the player wants to plunge ahead together or prepare carefully.
story.abigail.cave-invitation.02a.fallba: You really kept that quartz... Then I should be serious too. Want to explore the mines together next time? I am not scared. I just think we could go farther together. Would you charge ahead, or plan a way back first?
story.abigail.cave-invitation.02a.bold.t: I would go deeper with you.
story.abigail.cave-invitation.02a.bold.m: I agreed to adventure alongside Abigail and explore deeper into the mines.
story.abigail.cave-invitation.02a.carefu: Let us prepare. I want you to come back safely.
I agreed to adventure with Abigail, emphasizing that I want us both to return safely.
Let me think. I will answer another day.
I asked Abigail for time to think.
story.abigail.quartz-care.01.aiBrief: Abigail remembers the player's recent words. She approaches to check in and offers a piece of quartz she picked out. She tries to sound casual but cares about the response. Leave room for a sincere reply or light teasing.
story.abigail.quartz-care.01.fallbackTex:
I kept thinking about what you said last time. When I saw this quartz, it reminded me of you... Here. I just think it would look better with you.

({NpcDisplayName} offers you {GiftDisplayName}.)
story.abigail.quartz-care.01.cherish.tex: Accept it and promise to treasure it.
story.abigail.quartz-care.01.cherish.mem: I accepted the quartz sincerely and told Abigail I would treasure it.
story.abigail.quartz-care.01.tease.text: Accept it and ask if she picked it just for you.
story.abigail.quartz-care.01.tease.memor: I accepted the quartz and teased Abigail about choosing it especially for me.
story.abigail.quartz-care.01.defer.text: Not a good time. Let us talk another day.
story.abigail.quartz-care.01.defer.memor: I asked Abigail to come back another day.
story.abigail.rainy-challenge.02b.aiBrie: Abigail remembers the player asking whether she chose the quartz especially for them. She masks her embarrassment with a contest to find unusual stones, offering a chance for more teasing or an honest explanation of why the gift mattered.
story.abigail.rainy-challenge.02b.fallba: You really would not let that question go... Fine, I did spend a while choosing it. How about a contest next time it rains? Whoever finds the strangest stone gets to ask one question the other cannot dodge. Are you in?
story.abigail.rainy-challenge.02b.play-a: Of course. No backing out if you lose!
I accepted Abigail's challenge and playfully reminded her not to back out if she lost.
story.abigail.rainy-challenge.02b.honest: I asked because the gift meant a lot to me.
I told Abigail I asked because her quartz really mattered to me.
Spare me today. Let us compete another time.
I asked Abigail to save the challenge for another day.
story.abigail.starlight-promise.03.aiBri: The evening conclusion of this small relationship arc. Drawing on the player's recent answers about adventure, concern or teasing, Abigail admits she looks forward to seeing them. Rather than a direct confession, she sincerely asks how the player wants their relationship to develop.
story.abigail.starlight-promise.03.fallb: I keep thinking about what you said. Adventure used to mean heading into the unknown. Now... I look forward to having someone who will look back for me. Do not laugh. I want to ask seriously: where do you want us to go from here?
story.abigail.starlight-promise.03.stay-: I want to stay by your side.
I told Abigail I want to stay by her side.
story.abigail.starlight-promise.03.take-: Let us take our time. Just do not leave me behind.
I asked Abigail to grow closer slowly, and not to leave me behind.
story.abigail.starlight-promise.03.defer: I want to give this a proper answer next time.
I asked Abigail to let me give her a proper answer next time.
